title: 第23章 武祖绝学大荒囚天指第24章 半指压塌东离城
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 院落之中。
看著身旁碎成渣的木桩。
捏著双拳，簫火火脸上却有些意犹未尽的味道。
若是此前，他能在木桩上留下较深的一点痕跡，都能叫他兴奋半天了。
而如今轻易將八个木桩击毁，他却是多少有些不满。
萧火火低头沉思道：
“突破至链气境后，我的实力突飞猛进，已非常人所能及。”
“如果再度对上三长老的话，我定是能在十招之內，便让他溃败！”
他眼眸一闪，满脸的自信。
“如果，有武技在身的话，那不出三招，我便是能胜三长老！”
簫火火十分明白，现在他与人交手，靠的就是境界与他的一身蛮力。
虽然已经十分的不可思议，但他每一次出手却都有未能使出全力的挫败感。
也是了，武者需要武技才能將一身的武力完美的打出。
那他这个链气之人，是不是也能適配些武技？
让他能够更加完美的，施展出一身的手段？
越是想到这里，簫火火的神情越是激动：
“现在突破了链气境，与师尊说明白，看看能否……”
“说明白什么？”
忽地，一道突兀的响声，在簫火火的身后响起。
他浑身一颤，猛然回头看去，双眼放光惊喜的道：
“师尊！”
萧火火急忙躬身行礼。
低著的脸上，依旧是有些许震惊內心暗道：
“师尊真是感知敏锐。”
“每一次我突破无论是在山中，还是在府上，无论距离多远，他都是能清楚的感知到。”
“天底下，恐怕也只有师尊能做到这种事情了吧？”
瞥了他一眼，又看向旁的几个树桩，楚风便是隨意的走到了簫火火的身旁：
“火火啊，此前为师见你只是在纳灵入体阶段，需用心修行，不可分心其他。”
“那诸多招式秘法，都不適合让你修炼施展。”
楚风回过身，看向满脸激动，神色期待的簫火火，微微一笑道：
“如今你已突破了链气一层，也该是有著一招半式傍身了。”
闻言，簫火火再也站不住了，兴奋的跑到了楚风的面前：
content_en:
In the courtyard.
Looking at the broken wooden pile beside him.
Clenching her fists, Xiao Huohuo's face felt like she still had something to say.
If he had been able to leave a deep mark on the wooden pile before, he would have been excited for a long time.
But now that he easily destroyed eight wooden stakes, he was somewhat dissatisfied.
Xiao Huohuo lowered his head and thought deeply:
"After breaking through to the Chain Qi realm, my strength has improved by leaps and bounds, and it is beyond the reach of others."
"If I face the Third Elder again, I will definitely defeat him within ten moves!"
His eyes flashed, and his face was full of confidence.
"If I have martial arts skills, I can beat the three elders without using three moves!"
Xiao Huohuo understands very well that when he fights with others now, he relies on his realm and his brute strength.
Although it was already very incredible, every time he took a shot, he felt frustrated that he could not use his full strength.
That's right, a warrior needs martial arts to be able to use his entire body of force perfectly.
So, can he, a person with energy, be able to adapt to some martial arts?
So that he can display all his skills more perfectly?
The more he thought about this, the more excited Xiao Huohuo became:
"Now that I have broken through the chain energy realm, I will explain it to my master and see if I can..."
"Explain what?"
Suddenly, a sudden sound sounded behind Xiao Huohuo.
He trembled all over and suddenly looked back, his eyes shining with surprise and he said:
"Master!"
Xiao Huohuo hurriedly bowed and saluted.
The downcast face was still slightly shocked and he thought to himself:
"Master is really perceptive."
"Every time I break through, whether in the mountains or at home, no matter how far away, he can clearly sense it."
"I'm afraid Master is the only one in the world who can do such a thing, right?"
After glancing at him and then looking at the tree stumps nearby, Chu Feng casually walked to Xiao Huohuo:
"Huo Huo, my teacher has seen that you are only in the stage of absorbing the spirit into the body. You need to practice hard and don't be distracted by other things."
"Those many secret moves are not suitable for you to practice and use."
Chu Feng turned around, looked at Xiao Huohuo, who was full of excitement and expectation, smiled slightly and said:
"Now that you have broken through the first level of chain energy, you should have one and a half moves at your disposal."
Hearing this, Xiao Huohuo could no longer stand and ran to Chu Feng excitedly:
